title: Cem Karsan Explains the Quarter-End Flow Most Traders Never See
description:
Cem Karsan of Kai Volatility joins Overtime on the final day of the month and quarter to explain a flow most traders never see. Because most of the market runs on leverage, when stocks rise the whole system gains collateral: a 10% move on roughly 300 trillion of global equity creates about 30 trillion of fresh collateral that gets re-leveraged and put back to work. That re-leveraging concentrates at month, quarter and year end, which is a big part of why those windows are structurally supported, and why the year-end version drives the Santa Claus and January effects.
